name: Hetav Shah
summary: MBA (Finance major, Digital Transformation and Analytics minor) with a B.Tech in Computer Science, building AI systems that automate business and finance workflows end to end. I design the whole system first, build it AI-first and deploy it myself (Docker, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Render, Supabase, Linux VPS). Led the intern team at NTS Global Nihon. I pair production engineering with an MBA's business and analytics lens to turn manual workflows into governed, self-serve systems. Finance is a growing strength I am building alongside the MBA.
